_doc: Scripted question-detection cases. Each case is a sequence of turns replayed through the real TurnCoordinator + classifier as Flux events (StartOfTurn, Update, EagerEndOfTurn, EndOfTurn). `thread` seeds the question currently being answered. `expect` lists the questions that must fire, in order: `kind` must match and every `contains` keyword must appear (case-insensitive). Any extra fire is a false positive.
